# Blue Dot Technology

> AI implementation for operations: practical AI, automation and custom software that does the work inside existing processes, rather than more reports, dashboards or chatbots. Built, based and serviced in Dallas, Texas. Founded by an operator turned builder. Outcome-focused: no rip-and-replace, no single magic product; the goal is the business running better.

Blue Dot helps small and mid-sized businesses fix operational problems: invoices, approvals, reporting, vendor and payment controls, procurement records, field capture and compliance preparation. Work is delivered as fixed-scope sessions and sprints or ongoing fractional help. Demos run on illustrative or synthetic data; client work stays private.

## Services

Full pricing, terms and FAQ: https://smiddy.click/services/

Prices are published. Scope and timing are stated up front, and clients can stop after any step.

- [AI Opportunity Session](https://smiddy.click/services/ai-opportunity-session.html): $995, fixed. One working session to find where AI saves the most time. You get your top three quick wins, ranked, and a short written summary within 48 hours. The fee is credited toward any Sprint booked within 30 days.
- [Workflow Sprint](https://smiddy.click/services/workflow-sprint.html): from $4,500, fixed. Quick-Win Sprint, $4,500, about 2 weeks: a working prototype you can test plus a handoff session. Workflow Implementation Sprint, $8,500, 3 to 4 weeks: a multi-step workflow with integrations, tested and shipped. Larger scopes are quoted separately.
- [Fractional AI Implementation Lead](https://smiddy.click/services/ai-implementation-lead.html): $5,000 a month, about one day a week embedded with the team; includes a quarterly AI policy review. 3-month minimum, then 30 days' notice. AI tool fees are paid directly to vendors.
- [Other engagements](https://smiddy.click/approach.html#other): AI Use Policy Pack ($1,500, fixed), Fractional AI Officer, and an Enterprise AI Roadmap.

## Working builds (demos)

- [Traceable Metrics](https://smiddy.click/work/traceable-metrics.html): construction cost dashboard where every number opens to its records, approvals, documents and timing. Built in ICARUS, Blue Dot's operational software platform.
- [Traceable Procurement](https://smiddy.click/work/traceable-procurement.html): purchase orders traced from the original need to the final payment, including why a vendor was selected. Built in ICARUS.
- [Vendor Onboarding & Payment Controls](https://smiddy.click/work/vendor-onboarding.html): vendors can be set up immediately; payment stays locked until bank details are verified by phone. Built in ICARUS.
- [CMMC Controls Generator](https://smiddy.click/work/cmmc-controls.html): helps small defense contractors prepare for a CMMC Level 2 assessment with system-specific policy, procedure, evidence and assessor-prep documents. Preparation only; not a certification.

Each demo page lists what is built and what is not yet.
